final.narration: Published river flows are running about 33% too high, with the problem starting in mid-December 2024. Our best assessment is an unrecorded datum shift or gauge rebuild, though we have low confidence in this cause because downstream channel changes could also be responsible. Ask the USGS field office to verify whether the gauge elevation or reference marks were recently reset. Trust score 24/100 (Stale).

final.skeptic_argument: The ranker now goes beyond the field note and cites the geometry: at the same stage, area fell 11.3% while velocity fell 22.1%, which is the backwater pattern and much more velocity loss than area change. That supports a downstream control/fill-type explanation over a pure datum shift, but the top cause is still not scour, and the negative residual is consistent with a lowered conveyance condition.
